Description:
Behold, a knight clad in armor, commanding the king's army with unvavering determination, his presence inspiring the rallied masses trailing in his wake while striking fear into the hearts of the enemy ranks! A heavy blow of his lance shatters the enemy's defence line, clearing a path for victory. Radiating with divine energy of righteousness and bearing the standard of his allegiance, the Knight fearlessly presses forward, to victory!
Knights are the knights, the crusaders and the vigilantes who bear divine magic through conviction and purpose, perhaps aided by their god, rather than mastery over the arcane. They are able to both heal, resist damage and fell enemies with holy retribution.
Be it by the sword, by the shield or by the book, Knights join (or form) an order or community of like-minded individuals, and follow their calling into battle - to attack, to protect, to serve for a greater future.
Quick Note: Knights are the knights, the crusaders and the vigilantes who bear divine magic through conviction and purpose, perhaps aided by their god, rather than mastery over the arcane. They are able to both heal, resist damage and fell enemies with holy retribution.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Mana.Regain: Your Mana resets after every combat.
You regain all Mana at the end of each Worthy Combat.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Knight-specific Abilities are considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

~Blockade~.Effect:
When another Unit is targeted and attacked (after the roll), dash to the closest space to that ally.
You take the ^exact Damage^ instead of the Unit.

{Chain} Move: +100% Move Speed
{Chain} Half-Action Attack: +50% Damage
{Chain} Silver Grace: Gives you 1 Shielding equal to the Healed Amount.
~Blockade~.Upgrade: This Damage can only be mitigated by Shielding (and Silver Grace).

~Silver Grace~.Requirement: Only usable in Worthy Combat. Can't be used on Fallen Units.
~Silver Grace~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for 1d6 (but not yourself).
Your next attack until the end of your next Turn deals extra Damage equal to the amount just Healed.

{Chain} Other Healing: +50% Heal.
{Chain} Blockade: +100% Range and -2 Damage taken.
{Chain} Non-Healing Mana Ability: Costs 1 less Action Point.

~Smite~.Effect:
After you roll Damage for a melee attack or Spell made in melee range, add 1d6 Divine Damage.
If the target dies, regain 1 Mana.
~Smite~.Combo: Heal for the extra Damage dealt.
~Smite~.Notes: Melee range is 1 meter, longer if made with a Weapon with longer range.

~Invigorate~.Effect:
Heal a target for 1d4 + ^Presence or Intelligence^ Health.
After this, if the target is at full Health, repeat this on another target within 5 meters of you.
~Invigorate~.Combo: If the target is Comboed and still not full Health, increase the Healing by 50%.
~Invigorate~.Notes: Yes, this can chain again and again.

~Safeguard~.Effect:
A Unit you can see gains 2 Shieldings. Each can block 1d8 Damage.
Each die that rolled maximum applies a ~Combo~.

~Knighthood~.Effect: While mounted, after moving in a straight line at least 3 meters, your first attack this turn also hits a Unit directly behind the main target for 50% of the incoming Damage.
~Knighthood~.Combo: Each Comboed Unit hit becomes Single-Stunned.

~Light~.Effect:
Create a faithful source of light in a 3 meters radius (of any color).
It levitates and stays where you put it and can be moved by hand, or you can simply stick it to any solid object.
~Light~.Notes:
You may cancel it with 0 Actions. It can be purposefully destroyed with an Attack.
The light is not strong enough to blind someone.
The bulb can't go through solid objects.

~Guidance~.Effect: When an ally makes a Check, also add your respective Stat for that Check.

~Liberation~.Effect: Instantly remove all Crowd Control from another ally you can see.
~Liberation~.Upgrade:
At Level 5, also removes all non-magical debuffs and poisons.
At Level 8, also removes all curses and normal negative magical effects.

~Vault Break~.Effect:
Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
After casting this Ability, if you moved this turn, you can continue your movement.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.

~Lance Heave~.DisplayRequirement: Only usable if it hits at least 2 Units
~Lance Heave~.Effect:
Make a {Weapon} ^weapon^ attack {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~

{Chain} Blockade: +4 Range.
{Chain} Stun: Increase it by 1 tier.
{Chain} Deal Area Damage: Dice Upgraded to next die type.

Variants.Name: Lance Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits all Units in a 3-meter long line. The Damage is evenly split among all hit Units.

Variants.Name: Blade Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits all Units in a 3-meter long line. The Damage is evenly split among all hit Units.

Variants.Name: Penetrating Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits one more Unit up to 2 meters directly behind the main target.

Variants.Name: Piercing Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits one more Unit up to 2 meters directly behind the main target.

<Consacrated Ground>.Effect:
All ^enemies^ within 2 meters of you take 1d10 Fire Damage.
At the start of your next Turn, deal another 1d10 Fire Damage to all ^Units^ in the same area.

{Chain} Healing: Permanently increase their Health by 1.
{Chain} Blockade: Move the area with you. Only affects ^enemies^.
{Chain} Different Area Damage: +100% size and effects only ^enemies^.

<Templar Retribution>.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit.

{Chain} Healing: Clears all Crowd Control on the target.
{Chain} Crowd Control: Spreads to 1 other Unit within 5 meters of you.
{Chain} Divine Sense: Damages all unholies for 1d4. Heals all holies for 1d4.

<Join the Templar>.Effect: A party member pledges to you. They have the Blockade and Silver Grace Abilities.
<Join the Templar>.Upgrade: Ask a party member to join your cause and pledge their honor to you. Write a set of vows, which your companion must vow to abide to and follow with their life, upon death do you two apart.
<Join the Templar>.Notes:
Only one person can pledge for you and it must within sight or hearing to have access to all of those.
If you ever change this Talent, the ally loses access to all things mentioned; it regains them when you get this Talent again.

<Fellowship Aura>.Effect:
You stand out for allies near you.
Enemy ranged attacks against other allies within 1 meter of you have Cover.
<Fellowship Aura>.Notes: Nothing happens if an ally near you already has Cover. If playing on a grid, this does work for allies diagonally.

<Martyrdom>.Effect:
Use when an ally (or you) falls to 0 Health.
Immediately cast Holy Grace (or an upgraded version), ignoring its Cooldown and the Fallen Unit limitation.
<Martyrdom>.Notes: If that Fallen ally was healed, it Rises without Exhaustion.

<Knight in Black>.Effect:
Single-Stuns have no effect on your. Double-Stuns and Triple-Stuns only reduce your Actions by 1 and 2 (respectively).
While there are no allies within 4 meters of you, all your weapon attacks and self healing have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next dice type.
<Knight in Black>.Notes:
{DiceUpgrade}.
While _alone_, your healing Abilities have their Dice Upgraded when healing yourself.

<Man of Steel>.Effect: If you're wearing Heavy Armor or a Shield, you have +1 Defense and +5 Max Health.

<Broken Hearts>.Effect: All Damaged Enemies within 4 meters of you 2d4 + 1 True Damage and are Feared.
<Broken Hearts>.Notes: Cover is applied normally. Enemies with full Health are not affected.

~People's Temple~.Effect:
Create a sanctified space with a diameter equal to your Level centered on you.
While inside the space, Units can't be seen or heard from the outside.
Enemies tend to avoid the space, feeling a resistance against stepping towards the space.
At the end of the duration, all Units inside gain +1 Max Health.
~People's Temple~.Notes: If the Lodge would be destroyed with people inside, each will automatically be expulsed (appear) in a space within 3 meters of the door (randomly or by QM's choice).

~The Coming Again~.Effect:
When you die, your body stays unharmed for up to 7 days and enemies tend to avoid damaging you further, feeling a resistance against hurting your dead body.
When you use this Ability, you rise back from the dead with 15 Health and no Exhaustion, at any point within the 7 days.

<Personal Squire>.Effect:
You recruit a squire - a trusted NPC who gains combat powers. However, the capabilities of your squire are random: roll 1d6 to determine the type of your squire, based on the Squires category at Pets and Animals (1. Bold, 2. Sneaky, 3. Clever, 4. Wise). The Race is determined by the QM or by circumstance.
On its turn, it can do one Pet Attack, cast one Ability it has, or do the equivalent of a Half-Action (e.g. Dash, Push, etc).
You can recruit one squire per Adventure, but only one can follow you in your adventures at a time.
At the start of every Adventure (and when you get this Talent), you must spend 1 Mana and train your Squire to permanently increase its Health by 2 or gain one Ability from any other Squire type.
<Personal Squire>.Upgrade: If your squire drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It has no Health Regen, but at any point outside of combat, you (the pet owner) can spend 30 minutes to tend to your squire's wounds and heal it back to full Health.
<Personal Squire>.Notes: Your squire is not a Player Character by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Player Character can). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

<Pet Attack>.Effect:
The pet melee attacks a target.
The attack deals 1d6 Pierce of Slash Damage (your choice).

<Warrior Apparitions>.Effect:
Whenever you heal someone else, summon a Warrior Presence in any space near the target, with Health equal to the amount restored.
Warrior Spirits have 4 Speed and can attack for 1d4 Divine Damage. They take their turn after yours.

<Avenging Blockade>.Effect:
When another ally is targeted and attacked (after the roll), dash to the closest space to that ally.
You take the Damage instead of the ally, and the Damage is reduced by 2, ~then you can immediately make an attack (freely) with a 1-Handed Melee Weapon on the attacker that deals -50% Damage (if it's within 3 meters of you).~
<Avenging Blockade>.Notes: If the 1-Handed Weapon is not equipped, you quickly and freely equip it, attack, then switch back to your previous weapons.

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +5)
<Stat Bonus 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Stat Bonuses 4>.Effect: Gain +1 in two Stats of choice, up to +4.

<Vows of Unbreaking>.Effect:
Your Max Health (without buffs/items) increases by 100% and you become immune to curses, diseases and poison.
You automatically pass all Very Hard Might Checks (requiring at least 20).

<Vows of Truth>.Effect:
You may use Blockage an unlimited number of times per Round (ignoring its Reaction limit). The first time you use Blockade every Round, you take no Damage.
You gain +1 Might and Presence and you automatically pass all Hard Presence Checks (requiring at least 15).
Upon taking the Vows of Truth, you become incapable of telling lies, and you will only tell the truth as you see it (or avoid it).

<Legion of Oathsworn>.Effect:
In a place sanctified and pure, you start your own order of knights. Create a set of vows that your knights will abide to and have to recite to join you on your conquest.
You recruit a 3 beginner adventurer NPCs as squires! Each is one of the 4 possible squire types from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`: Bold, Sneaky, Clever or Wise, whichever makes fits better story-wise (or random). All your squires must be different types.
Passively, gain +2 in all Stats.
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Upgrade: If your squire drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It has no Health Regen, but at any point outside of combat, you (the pet owner) can spend 30 minutes to tend to your squire's wounds and heal it back to full Health.
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Notes: Your squire is not a Player Character by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Player Character can). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

~Squire Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of the weapon's type, or do the equivalent of a Half-Action (e.g. Sprint, Push, etc).
